description: record that a registered joseki card produced one successful run: increment its run-evidence counter, stamp the last-run timestamp, and promote a candidate card to proven once it has at least one recorded run.
embedding_description: Log a successful execution of an authored joseki pattern as run evidence on its lifecycle row. Increments the run counter and last-run time, and advances a candidate joseki to proven because proven means at least one recorded successful run. This is evidence about the reusable joseki card itself, not a per-step observation inside a work-breakdown execution.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Run-evidence result with keys: joseki_key, state, run_count, wbs_id, status
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report the joseki_key, its run_count after this record, and its state — note when a candidate has just been earned into proven.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The run evidence is durable. A candidate with its first recorded run is now proven; a card that was already proven simply gains a run. Continue the current plan.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Recording run evidence for an authored joseki card so it can be earned into the proven state. record_authored_joseki_run accepts {joseki_key, wbs_id?}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: JosekiNotFound: no lifecycle row exists for the key. StateConflict: the card is a draft (never validated), superseded, or archived — only a candidate or proven card accepts run evidence — or the row changed underneath the compare-and-set.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Draft cards: promote the card to candidate (which validates it) before recording a run. Superseded or archived cards: use the current replacement card instead. Conflicts from a concurrent update: re-read with get_authored_joseki and resubmit.
